'''Trailblaze''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for boots that makes the wearer faster on paths, gravel and mud bricks. Its internal name is ''Traversal''.

== Obtaining ==
* [[Prayer of St. Clement]], a crafted [[blessing]] (Trailblaze III). It stores <code>matcha:traversal</code> directly, so applying it to boots that already have Trailblaze does not go past level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref>
* The Prayer of Exodus [[Ofuda]], traded from the [[Mouthpiece]] for [[The Tanakh]] (Trailblaze III, with Loyalty III and Power II).
* [[Sturdy Leather Boots]] are crafted with Trailblaze I, and those found in chests have it too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_boots.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
=== Speed ===
The enchantment adds 0.0155 movement speed per level (to the base player speed of 0.1), so Trailblaze III makes the wearer about 46% faster. It does not apply while riding or flying.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>

The boost runs on a short buffer, so it isn't lost the moment the wearer steps off a path block. Each tick the wearer walks along the ground on a path block, the buffer fills by 2, up to 20; every tick it drains by 1. The boost lasts as long as the buffer isn't empty, so it builds up while walking on paths, survives jumps, and runs out about one second after leaving them. On a path that mixes path blocks with other blocks, the boost holds as long as path blocks make up about half of the steps.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/traversal.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/tick.mcfunction}}</ref>

The path blocks are the pack's <code>#matcha:is_path</code> tag:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/is_path.json}}</ref>
* {{MCW|Dirt Path|dirt path}} and {{MCW|Coarse Dirt|coarse dirt}}
* {{MCW|Gravel|gravel}}
* {{MCW|Packed Mud|packed mud}}
* {{MCW|Mud Bricks|mud bricks}}, mud brick slabs and mud brick stairs
* [[Dirt Slab]]s

=== Durability and particles ===
While the boost is active, each time the wearer moves to another block on the ground, the boots have a 4% chance to lose 1 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref> Walking on a path block kicks up dirt particles every 5 ticks.

Trailblaze's anvil cost multiplier is 8, and its enchanting table cost is 10 plus 10 per level above the first.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>

== Issues ==
* The developer's notes for earlier versions record that the speed boost from mud brick slabs applied after a jump but not when running normally.<ref>{{Cite changelog|quote=When running on mud brick slabs with traversal boots, when I jump I get the speed boost, but when I just run on it normally I don't get the speed boost}}</ref>

{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Now works on mud brick slabs and stairs and dirt slabs. Speed raised from 0.0105 to 0.0155 per level.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Buffed Trailblaze speed (0.0105 / lvl -> 0.0155 / lvl)}}</ref>}}

{{History line|1.12.3|The Prayer of St. Clement stores Trailblaze directly, so it no longer raises boots past level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|2=Reworked for ''Minecraft'' 26.3.
